//: Emits runnable JavaScript for `npm run bench`. Separate from ./tsconfig.json because it has the opposite job: that one typechecks the workload as a composite project so the test suite can import it, this one produces .js a bare `node` can execute.
//2: It compiles src/ and bench/ together into one output tree rather than consuming packages/sim-core/dist through a project reference. That is deliberate: bench/population.ts imports '../src/*.js' relatively, and only a shared rootDir keeps those specifiers resolving after emit. A project reference would typecheck fine and produce JavaScript whose imports point at .ts files that node cannot load.
